scope.summary: Implement sections partitioning a document for numbering: a named section restarts page numbering at a chosen start value, selects a number style (arabic, roman upper/lower, alphabetic, and locale-specific styles), optionally carries a section prefix and marker, and carries a per-section include-on-export flag. Section state is a record on the owning StudioPageSpread range (field-defined in 14.23). Typed command + studio.layout events; model-steerable and operator-facing.
acceptance_criteria: named sections restart numbering with all number styles + prefix/marker + include-on-export; StudioPageSpread-scoped
proof_targets: section restart + number-style runtime; include-on-export test
expected_tests: live: section restarts numbering at start value with chosen number style + prefix/marker
test: per-section include-on-export flag honored on export; section record scoped to StudioPageSpread range

target_entries: Studio / Page Layout / Sections & page numbering

risk_if_missed: No section numbering; front-matter/roman-then-arabic documents impossible; export scoping broken.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
